name: tvmaze-mcp-server
description: Television series and episode schedules — search shows, next episodes in your timezone, episode guides, daily broadcast and streaming schedules, and cast via TVmaze.

TVMAZE_BASE_URL.title: TVmaze Base URL
TVMAZE_BASE_URL.description: TVmaze API base URL. Override to point at an enterprise endpoint.

TVMAZE_USER_AGENT.title: User Agent
TVMAZE_USER_AGENT.description: User-Agent sent on every upstream request. TVmaze asks that clients identify themselves. Leave blank to use the server name, version, and repository URL.

TVMAZE_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE.title: Default Timezone
TVMAZE_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone used when a tool call omits the timezone argument (e.g. America/Los_Angeles).

TVMAZE_DEFAULT_COUNTRY.title: Default Country
TVMAZE_DEFAULT_COUNTRY.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used for schedule scopes linear and all when country is omitted.

TVMAZE_CACHE_TTL_S.title: Cache TTL (seconds)
TVMAZE_CACHE_TTL_S.description: Seconds to hold an upstream response in the in-process cache. 0 disables caching.
